paragraphs.en: Malika is twelve years old. She lives with her parents and her little brother in a flat in Bukhara.
paragraphs.uz: Malika o'n ikki yoshda. U ota-onasi va ukasi bilan Buxorodagi kvartirada yashaydi.

paragraphs.en: Last week, her father came home with a small box. In the box there was a little grey cat. "Is it for me?" Malika asked. "Yes, it's for you and your brother," her father said.
paragraphs.uz: O'tgan hafta otasi uyga kichkina quti bilan keldi. Qutida kichkina kulrang mushuk bor edi. "Bu menga-mi?" — so'radi Malika. "Ha, senga va ukangga," — dedi otasi.

paragraphs.en: The cat's name is Paxta, because she is soft and white on her face. Paxta likes milk and fish. She doesn't like water!
paragraphs.uz: Mushukning ismi Paxta, chunki u yumshoq va yuzi oppoq. Paxta sut va baliqni yaxshi ko'radi. Suvni yoqtirmaydi!

paragraphs.en: Every morning, Paxta sleeps on Malika's bed. In the afternoon, she plays with a ball under the table. In the evening, she sits next to the window and looks at the birds.
paragraphs.uz: Har kuni ertalab Paxta Malikaning karavotida uxlaydi. Tushdan keyin stol ostida koptok bilan o'ynaydi. Kechqurun deraza yonida o'tirib, qushlarga qaraydi.

paragraphs.en: Malika loves her cat. "Paxta is my best friend," she says.
paragraphs.uz: Malika mushugini juda yaxshi ko'radi. "Paxta — mening eng yaqin do'stim," deydi u.

questions.q: Where does Paxta sleep in the morning?
